prompt_text: What is the best AI video ad maker?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: There’s no single “best” AI video ad maker for everyone — the right tool depends on your goals, budget, ad style, and channels. That said, these are the top options (with why and when to pick each):

Top picks
- Synthesia / HeyGen / Movio (AI-presenter tools)
  - Best if you want realistic virtual presenters/voiceover in many languages.
  - Pros: polished talking-heads, fast script→video, brand control.
  - Use when you need product explainers or spokesperson-style ads without actors.

- InVideo / Lumen5 / Canva (template-based editors with AI features)
  - Best for fast, template-driven social ads and promos.
  - Pros: large template libraries, easy scene assembly, good for e‑commerce creatives.
  - Use when you need many variations and quick turnarounds.

- Pictory / Repurpose.io (repurposing/long‑form→short)
  - Best for turning webinars/blog posts/long videos into short ad clips.
  - Pros: auto-summarize, captions, highlight extraction.

- Runway / Kaiber (generative creative + advanced editing)
  - Best for eye-catching, creative visuals or generative video elements.
  - Pros: advanced AI effects, ideal if you want unique visuals rather than presenter-driven ads.

- CapCut / Descript (short-form editing + speech tools)
  - Best for UGC-style ads and social verticals; Descript is great for spoken-word editing and overdubs.
  - Pros: free/low-cost options, fast vertical editing, good for TikTok/IG Reels.

How to choose
- Ad style: spokesperson (Synthesia/HeyGen) vs. template social ad (InVideo/Canva) vs. creative visuals (Runway).
- Platforms & aspect ratios: ensure the tool exports 9:16 / 1:1 / 16:9 and captions.
- Speed vs control: templates = fast; Runway/Studio = more creative control.
- Languages & voices: check multilingual TTS support if you need it.
- Commercial rights & licensing: important for ads—verify commercial use, stock assets rights.
- Budget & scale: many have free trials; paid plans vary widely and enterprise pricing can be required for high volume.

Practical recommendation
- If you want one pick for polished, scalable ad production with virtual spokespeople: try Synthesia (or HeyGen/Movio as alternatives).
- If you want low-cost, fast social ads and templates: try InVideo or Canva Pro.
- If repurposing long content: try Pictory.
- If you want standout generative visuals: try Runway.

If you tell me: platform (Facebook/YouTube/TikTok), ad length, tone (product demo, testimonial, UGC, animated), and budget, I’ll recommend the single best tool and suggest a quick template/script you can use.
